# Savvagent SDKs

> Savvagent is an AI-powered feature flag platform that prevents production incidents. This repository contains official SDKs for TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Vue, Svelte, Next.js, Node.js, Go, Java, Rust, iOS, and Android.

Savvagent feature flags enable safe rollouts with automatic error detection and correlation. The platform tracks flag evaluations and correlates production errors with recent flag changes using AI.

## Core Concepts

- **Feature Flags**: Boolean toggles that control feature visibility
- **Context**: User/session data for targeted rollouts (userId, attributes)
- **Real-time Updates**: Server-Sent Events push flag changes instantly
- **Telemetry**: Automatic tracking of evaluations and errors
- **AI Error Detection**: Correlates production errors with flag changes

## Quick Start (TypeScript)

```typescript
import { FlagClient } from '@savvagent/sdk';

const client = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: 'sdk_your_key_here',
  baseUrl: 'https://flags-api.savvagent.com',
});

// Check if flag is enabled
const enabled = await client.isEnabled('new-feature', {
  userId: 'user-123',
  attributes: { plan: 'pro' },
});

// Execute code conditionally with automatic error tracking
await client.withFlag('experimental', async () => {
  await experimentalFeature();
});
```

- [React SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/savvagent/savvagent-sdks/main/packages/react/README.md): React hooks for feature flags
- [Vue SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/savvagent/savvagent-sdks/main/packages/vue/README.md): Vue 3 composables
- [Svelte SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/savvagent/savvagent-sdks/main/packages/svelte/README.md): Svelte stores
- [Next.js SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/savvagent/savvagent-sdks/main/packages/nextjs/README.md): App Router and Pages Router support
- [Node.js Server SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/savvagent/savvagent-sdks/main/packages/node-server/README.md): Server-side SDK for Express, Fastify, etc.
- [Go Server SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/savvagent/savvagent-sdks/main/packages/go-server/README.md): Idiomatic Go with goroutine-safe access
- [Java Server SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/savvagent/savvagent-sdks/main/packages/java-server/README.md): Thread-safe for Spring Boot, etc.
- [Rust Server SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/savvagent/savvagent-sdks/main/packages/rust-server/README.md): Async/await with Tokio
- [iOS SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/savvagent/savvagent-sdks/main/packages/ios-sdk/README.md): Swift with async/await, SwiftUI support
- [Android SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/savvagent/savvagent-sdks/main/packages/android-sdk/README.md): Kotlin with Jetpack Compose

## API Reference

### FlagClient Configuration

```typescript
interface FlagClientConfig {
  apiKey: string;              // Required: SDK key (starts with sdk_)
  baseUrl?: string;            // API URL (default: production)
  enableRealtime?: boolean;    // SSE updates (default: true)
  cacheTtl?: number;           // Cache TTL in ms (default: 60000)
  enableTelemetry?: boolean;   // Track evaluations (default: true)
  defaults?: Record<string, boolean>;  // Fallback values
  onError?: (error: Error) => void;    // Error handler
}
```

### FlagClient Methods

- `isEnabled(flagKey, context?)` - Returns boolean, checks if flag is enabled
- `evaluate(flagKey, context?)` - Returns detailed result with reason and metadata
- `withFlag(flagKey, callback, context?)` - Executes callback if flag enabled, tracks errors
- `trackError(flagKey, error, context?)` - Manually track error with flag context
- `subscribe(flagKey, callback)` - Subscribe to real-time flag updates
- `getCachedFlags()` - Get all cached flag keys
- `clearCache()` - Force re-evaluation
- `close()` - Cleanup resources

### Context Object

```typescript
interface EvaluationContext {
  userId?: string;           // User identifier for targeting
  attributes?: {             // Custom attributes for rules
    [key: string]: string | number | boolean;
  };
}
```
